notes.title: New Power-Up System
notes.content:
[h1]New Update Here![/h1]

[h2]What's new?[/h2]
I've recently been working on changing up the Power's available in the game and have done just that! While it may look small on the surface with only one new power up implemented (Double Damage - Double's the damage of all weapons) this new system will make the implementation of new power up's much easier so look out for new power ups in the following updates. Outside of this, I have fixed some bugs and that's really it!

Enjoy!
